reason: This passage (Exodus 3-4) describes God's call to Moses to lead the Israelites out of Egyptian bondage. The leadership model presented is grounded in divine authority, communication facilitated by signs and wonders (the burning bush, the staff-serpent miracle, and the hand signs), and the delegated power of speech—not in violence towards unruly people. The text emphasizes liberation from oppression and credibility through divine signs. There is no element suggesting that violence toward unruly people constitutes a model for good leadership.
story: Moses meets Yahweh in the Burning Bush
